phrase.en: Can you explain your solution to the team? A quick summary is fine.
phrase.ru: Можешь объяснить своё решение команде? Хватит короткого резюме.
phrase.es: ¿Puedes explicar tu solución al equipo? Basta con un resumen rápido.

text.ru: explain что-то кому-то — explain it to me, а не explain me. Так же: describe it to me, say it to me (но tell me).
text.en: explain something to someone — explain it to me, not explain me. The same with describe and say (but tell me).
text.es: explain algo to alguien: explain it to me, no explain me. Igual con describe y say (pero tell me).

examples.en: Could you explain it to me again?

exercises.en: Can you ___ the error to me?
Please explain it to the client.

answer: Can you explain it to me?
